title: Clone Any Voice Instantly with OpenVoice (Free & Open Source)
description:
OpenVoice clones any voice from a short audio clip instantly. It's an open-source model from MIT and MyShell that lets you control emotion, accent, and rhythm across 6 languages. Free for commercial use.
